## c22ce0168b97

**Reproduced defect: canonical semantic-role coverage hole.** Generator SHA-256 `f33d8a070e32a141bc7a700830c94272e1172a7fda39e418d8f082fc73373d46`; rule hash `cf99c23cda87`.

The ordinary sampler excludes color 8 from top-row header colors, but canonical test pair 0 contains an 8 in the header and body markers in color 8. That canonical input passes the target's current `self_check`, yet it is outside the documented ordinary sampling distribution. In 600 ordinary draws—200 seeds per easy/medium/hard band, `sample_index = seed*17+3`—the top row contained color 8 in 0/600 cases (`checks/audit/c22ce0168b97/probe.json`).

The retained rival is: for each body color-8 cell, copy its top-row header only when that header is nonzero and not 8; otherwise clear it to 0. It fits every canonical training pair but clears the marker under the canonical test's 8-header. The supported Racket application keeps that marker as 8, so the predictions differ (`checks/audit/c22ce0168b97/input.json`, `racket.json`, and `rival.json`). Command, cwd, input/output hashes, generator hash, and executed rule hash are embedded in `racket.json`. No patch was made to this audit target.
